title: Acyclicity of tableau gates
statement: Let $M$ be a deterministic Turing machine with a finite number of work tapes and Boolean input and output symbols, and let $n,t$ be natural numbers. In the gate list for the tableau of $M$ on an input of length $n$ through time $t$, every argument of gate $i$ has index strictly less than $n+i$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state Turing machine with Boolean symbols
